evidence_basis.continuity: Exact prior source-session JSONL continuity evidence supplied on 2026-07-30.
evidence_basis.corroboration: The independent closure review reported 21 package trees: five active and 16 preserved superseded trees, with the preserved digest-to-edition and superseded-by bindings recovered from the historical inventory.
evidence_basis.defect_scope: The independent closure review reported that all 16 preserved pre-correction TEI documents failed validation against the vendored tei_all.xsd. No narrower per-digest defect claim is made here.
